# Example Store Policy

This is synthetic test data for document retrieval and question answering.

## Returns

Unused products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery.
A receipt is required. Final-sale products are not eligible for return.

## Support

Support is available Monday through Friday, from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.

## Shipping

Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.

## Evidence limits

This document does not specify a warranty duration or a refund processing time.
